messages:
mike.h: Observed 5% error spike on model v2.3.1 in us-west1 after a config drift. Telemetry shows tokenizer mismatch causing truncated tokens. Requesting emergency pin to v2.3.0 and skip canary for a hotfix. tagging @paula.ops @sre-oncall

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Release plan created: hotfix/v2.3.0-pin-2026-03-20. Checks: ci:pass, e2e:fail (canary). Canary failed on 1 node: tokenization mismatch. Can skip canary with 2x approvers OR SRE override.

jen.devex: Can we get quick validation steps? what's the minimum rollforward size? :eyes:

paula.ops: +1 for pin. We need release notes: 'Revert tokenizer change introduced in v2.3.1 causing truncated tokens'. Also add a router migration note and customer-facing blurb.

ryan.prodops: SRE metrics: error_rate > 3% for 5m in us-west1, latency normal. Recommend pin and partial rollforward to 30% with healthcheck 2m.

sre-oncall: I'll own the rollback window. If error_rate > 2% for 10m after roll, we abort and roll back. Approving skip-canary for ops. :white_check_mark:

release-manager: We need a second approver to skip canary. @jen.devex, can you +1?

jen.devex: +1. Verified repro locally against v2.3.1 and confirmed fix with v2.3.0. Approve skip-canary. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Approval threshold reached. Scheduling deploy: hotfix/v2.3.0-pin-2026-03-20 -> us-west1. Steps:
1) Pin model version on gateway
2) Deploy runtime patch to 25% traffic
3) Monitor metrics 10m
4) Scale to 100% if stable
Command: ```redwoodctl release apply --name hotfix/v2.3.0-pin-2026-03-20 --pin-version v2.3.0 --regions us-west1 --start-percent 25 --canary-skip```

mike.h: Executing now, pushing command to prod.

deploy-bot: starting step 1 - gateway pinning... done (txn 0x9f3a).

paula.ops: rolling to 25% now. Monitoring logs — traces show token mismatch stack decreasing.

sre-oncall: 4m in, error_rate back to baseline 0.5%. continuing to monitor.

mike.h: moving to 100% in 6m if stable. tagging docs for quick release note update @release-manager

release-manager: updated release notes and notified customer success. Sending short blip to #announcements.

deploy-bot: rollforward to 100% completed. All checks green. hotfix/v2.3.0-pin-2026-03-20 deployed.

paula.ops: postmortem follow-up to be scheduled. We'll capture root cause: tokenizer change slipped through evals and gating. Action items: tighten eval set, add pre-release tokenization smoke, and add version pin gating for major tokenizer changes. :spiral_calendar:

mike.h: thanks all — great quick sync. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
